LESSON: SLAVERY AND SERVITUDE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.3: Slavery and Servitude

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Slavery and Servitude. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why has slavery and servitude existed for thousands of years?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
2. explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade
   In simple words: practise until you can explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Slavery and Servitude using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Slavery and Servitude in the examples.
2. Explain Slavery and Servitude to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Slavery and Servitude.
4. Show that you can: identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Slavery and Servitude using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Slavery and Servitude important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society,
2. Draw the geographical extent of the regions covered by the Indian Ocean Slave trade in Africa,
3. Communication and Collaboration: learners contribute to group decision-making as they brainstorm on the meaning of slavery and servitude and share their findings in class.
4. Unity: learners work in groups to brainstorm on various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African society.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
2. explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
